prose:
Gary Marcus argues that early trading weakness undermines celebratory narratives around Anthropic’s offering and predicts wider financial stress for AI companies. The post uses opening, closing and premarket prices to make its case.

The market observations are time-specific and its predictions about future offerings, cash and a death spiral are opinion, not demonstrated outcomes. The post does not establish that every AI stock has fallen by the title’s aggregate figure or supply a reproducible sector index here.
highlights: Post is a strongly argued opinion
Sector-wide title lacks an examined index method
Future financing failure is a prediction
